#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> odd(n);
    odd[0] = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + ((a[i] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1);
    }

    vector<int> price(n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        price[i] = abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]);
    }

    vector<int> prices;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (odd[i] == 0) {
            prices.push_back(price[i]);
        }
    }

    sort(prices.begin(), prices.end());

    int ans = 0;
    for (int cost : prices) {
        if (b < cost) {
            break;
        }
        b -= cost;
        ++ans;
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
